rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to refer to a person aged thirteen to nineteen.

example.english: Your son is a teen now, so you don't need to keep following him around.
example.traditional: 你個仔已經係十幾歲嘅人，唔使成日跟住佢喇。
